noise: improved Perlin 3D gradient noise (quintic fade, seeded permutation) sampled on the unit sphere: seamless, no pole pinching; fBm lacunarity 2.0, gain 0.5

planet.continents: fBm 6 octaves @ freq 1.18 over a domain warp (3 x fBm 4 octaves @ 1.5, amplitude 0.17)
planet.mountains: ridged multifractal 5 octaves @ 2.6, land only, weight 0.46
planet.clouds: warped fBm 7 octaves @ 2.3 + latitude belts, smoothstep(0.16, 0.40), alpha 0.88
planet.clay: same continents, two sculpted terraces (smoothstep edges), flat oceans, ceramic grain in the normal map

moon.craters: hashed 3D cells, 6 octaves, cell sizes [0.78, 0.4, 0.21, 0.115, 0.062, 0.034]; bowl + central peak + rim + ejecta, wobble 0.16/0.07, age softening

channels: height 8-bit (planet: 0.5 = sea level) + 16-bit; normal = tangent space, OpenGL (G = north / up in the image); colour sRGB; roughness linear; clouds RGBA (alpha = density); row 0 = north pole; u 0..1 = longitude -180..180 degrees; PNGs are untagged
